description:
Cast Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Urabrask triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting Seething Song.
Urabrask triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve Reiterate, copying Seething Song and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
